title: verify.rs: verify_one repeats SignerResult failure construction 5 times
description: verify_one has 5 early-return arms each constructing SignerResult { verified: false, subject: ..., error: Some(e.to_string()) } manually. The repetition obscures the verification flow — a reader must scan all five arms to understand the control structure. Suggested rewrite: extract a helper 'fn fail(subject: Option<String>, e: impl Display) -> SignerResult' and use the ? operator via a Result-returning inner function. The outer verify_one converts the inner Err to a failed SignerResult in one place. This makes the happy path readable without all the early-return noise.
